summary: Engine install screen strobes between a "preparing dependencies" label and the download byte counter during the dependency phase. Reported live on Linux; cosmetic, install completes. Candidate cause (unverified): engine:extracting and engine:downloading events interleaving so the install screen flips view on every event.

MERGED into MPI-410, closed as done/rejected (not built, kept as the record). Both are first-run-only visual defects on the boot into install path, both are cosmetic (nothing fails), and both are reproduced by the same act: a cold first launch that goes on to install an engine. One investigation session covers the pair. Original card text stays at tasks/MPI-412/. Part of the 2026-08-01 board reorg: 42 todo cards -> 31.
